newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Kemongsa delays bond issue for foreigners.
newsitem.headline: Kemongsa delays bond issue for foreigners.

text.p: South Korea's Kemongsa Publishing Co Ltd has delayed a plan to issue 30 billion won in corporate bonds exclusively for foreign investors, a company official said on Wednesday.
The publisher originally planned to issue the non-guaranteed bonds, carrying a 10.25 percent coupon rate, in early February.
"Foreigners asked to raise the rate as they were concerned about the nation's economic fundamentals," the official said.
Yields on benchmark three-year corporate bonds, guaranteed by commercial banks, stood at 12.90 percent.
"We will delay the issue until arrangers and foreign underwriters come to a compromise over the pricing."
The deadline for the bond issue is set at April 25.
